name: htcarr3
description: Personal Claude Code plugins — workflow toolkits pulled in per project.

plugins.name: unknowns
plugins.description: Field-guide techniques for surfacing unknowns before, during, and after implementation, as invokable skills that emit self-contained HTML artifacts.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: The self-improvement layer — research current Claude Code / model best practice from live docs, audit this project's config against it, and apply the gaps. Grounds in fresh docs instead of baked-in knowledge that goes stale.

plugins.name: review-flow
plugins.description: Branch review & session helpers: tour a branch commit-by-commit, vet a cold-session review against the real code, and replay messy history into clean commits.

plugins.name: html-docs
plugins.description: Emit polished, self-contained HTML documents on one consistent Anthropic-style design system — reports, plans, explainers, comparisons, dashboards, editors — so you decide what to say, not how to build the page.
